target.title: fix(gateway): defer hot-reload restart when dist/entry.js is missing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Pushing commits into a live production git checkout triggers the gateway's hot-reload while `dist/` is mid-rebuild. The watcher (`requestRestart()` in `scripts/watch-node.mjs`) immediately sends SIGTERM to the current healthy child process without checking whether the replacement build is valid for the new checkout state. The new child cannot start → crash-loop until systemd's start-limit is exhausted (37-min outage, P1, issue #99603).

## Changes

Three layers in `scripts/watch-node.mjs`:

### 1. isBuildReadyForRestart(cwd, fs, resolveHead)

Comprehensive guard mirroring `run-node`'s `resolveBuildRequirement()`:
- `dist/entry.js` exists
- Build stamp (`dist/.buildstamp`) has valid `builtAt`
- Build stamp git HEAD matches current checkout HEAD
- Config files (`tsdown.config.ts`, `tsconfig.json`, `package.json`) mtime not newer than stamp
- Runtime postbuild stamp (`dist/.runtime-postbuildstamp`) exists with `syncedAt >= builtAt`

### 2. Deferred restart polling (1s interval)

When build is not ready, polls every 1s. When build output becomes ready, auto-triggers restart — no manual file change needed.

### 3. Exit handler guard

After SIGTERM/143 child exit, verifies build readiness before restarting. Prevents self-reinforcing crash-loop.

## Evidence

### Real gateway:watch proof (current SHA 03954beb)

```
REAL gateway:watch PROOF — SHA: 03954beb32ea
Hostname: LIN-66D8BD4EA2C
Node: v24.13.1

─── 1. isBuildReadyForRestart ───
  ✅ entry.js missing → false
  ✅ no readFileSync (fallback) → true
  ✅ HEAD mismatch (has runtime stamp) → false
  ✅ HEAD match (has runtime stamp) → true

─── 2. Guard points in source ───
  Guard checks: 3 (requestRestart + exit handler + polling)
  Polling reset on settle: yes
  isBuildReadyForRestart exported: yes

─── 3. Unit tests ───
  Test Files  1 passed (1), Tests  24 passed (24)

─── 4. Lint ───
  Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.
```

### Unit tests (24/24 passed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/watch-node.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  24 passed (24)
```

### Broader regression (91/91 passed)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/run-node.test.ts src/infra/watch-node.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  91 passed (91)
```

### CI status

All checks-node-compact-small-* pass. Lint + type-check clean.

## Review

- Manually reviewed and verified
- AI-assisted: Yes
- **Partial mitigation** — prevents crash-loop; issue #99603 should remain open for transactional restart (build-then-swap)
- Competing PRs #99610, #99972 target same root cause; maintainers should choose one canonical fix
